scenes.narration: How did Marriott collect 5.4 billion dollars in fees from other people's hotels?
Owners pay Marriott for its name, for running the hotel, and bonuses when profits rise.
Its total revenue looks much bigger: 26.2 billion dollars.
But 19.2 billion of that is owners paying Marriott back for costs.
Fees were about 21 percent of revenue. Net income was 2.6 billion dollars.
